title: Dark mode for Notebook (simple example)
task: Example deck: a small plan with one design question, to try the deck in a minute
summary: A small plan to try the deck with. Click a **mock screen** to try it, **Pick** an option, then answer the cards below.
goal: People can switch Notebook to dark mode, and it stays that way.

decisions.title: Where does the dark mode switch live?
decisions.summary: Two ways to turn dark mode on. Try both, then pick one.
decisions.building: A way to switch between light and dark. **Recommended: A**, because it also lets people follow their device. The plan below is written for it; pick B and the intents follow.

options.label: A. In Settings
options.caption: Three choices: Light, Dark or Follow system. Two clicks away.

options.label: B. A button in the top bar
options.caption: One click, always in view. No Follow system choice.

decisions.title: Where is the choice saved?
decisions.summary: On this device only, or on the account so it follows you.
decisions.building: Where Notebook remembers Light, Dark or Follow system.
tradeoffs: **On the account**: the choice follows you to your phone. Needs one new field and one API call.
**On this device**: nothing to build on the server. Each device has to be set once.

intents.title: Switch to dark, and it stays
intents.intent: I want to choose Dark once and have every page dark, also after I reload or come back tomorrow.

verify.expected: Choose Dark, reload: the page is still dark.

intents.title: Follow my device until I choose
intents.intent: I want Notebook to match my device's light or dark setting until I pick one myself.

verify.expected: With no choice saved and the device set to dark, the page opens dark.

boundaries.title: Only colours change
boundaries.boundary: Dark mode changes colours only. No layout, text or note content changes.

steps.title: Colours as theme variables
steps.description: Move the app's colours into one set of variables with a light and a dark value each.

steps.title: Appearance in Settings
steps.description: Three choices in Settings: Light, Dark, Follow system. The page changes as soon as one is picked.

steps.title: Remember the choice
steps.description: Save the choice and read it before the first paint, so there is no flash of the wrong theme.

finalVerify.expected: Choose Dark, reload: the page is still dark.
With no choice saved and the device set to dark, the page opens dark.
